title.zh: 综合项目 · 维修站温度巡查报告
title.en: Final Project · Station Heat Inspection Report

brief.zh: 用同一份传感器日志，决定最近三天哪些区域要优先巡查。一步步查看筛选、清洗、汇总和 SQL 查询产生的表。
brief.en: Use one set of sensor logs to decide which areas to inspect first for the latest three days. See the table produced by each filtering, cleaning, summary, and SQL step.

concept.zh: 把每一步的真实输出交给下一步，从原始日志得到可以决定巡查次序的报告。
concept.en: Feed each step’s actual output into the next to turn raw logs into an inspection priority report.

hints.zh: 最近三天从第 2 天开始。最后先巡查平均温度最高的区域，其次检查排名第二的区域。
hints.en: The latest three days start on day 2. Inspect the area with the highest mean first, followed by the runner-up.

label.en: NumPy · Select the latest three days

prompt.zh: 选择日期列，用掩码保留第 2 天及之后的所有原始记录。
prompt.en: Use a mask on the day column to keep every raw reading from day 2 onward.

prompt.zh: 规范区域名称，把可用温度转为数字，去掉无效读数，按编号去重。
prompt.en: Normalize area names, convert usable temperatures to numbers, drop invalid readings, and deduplicate by ID.

label.zh: 统计 · 算每区平均值

prompt.zh: 用刚刚清洗出的温度，按区域计算第 2 至 4 天的平均温度。
prompt.en: Use the cleaned readings to find each area’s mean temperature over days 2 through 4.

prompt.zh: 从汇总表中选出平均温度至少 25°C 的区域，让温度最高的排在最前面。
prompt.en: Query the summary for areas with a mean of at least 25°C. Put the highest mean first.
